episodes.title: Kenneth Copeland Shoves a Disabled Man and Calls It a Healing
episodes.description: Kenneth Copeland shoves a wheelchair-bound man backward while praising Jesus, and the man still can't stand. That's just the opening of this deep dive into the Christian nationalist grift machine, where we trace fabricated history, fake persecution stories, and outright calls for violence back to their sources. We break down Gene Bailey's book Killing America, which uses the David and Goliath story to tell Christians they'll be rewarded by God for killing their enemies, and we check his claims about the Supreme Court, Ronald Reagan, and separation of church and state against what actually happened. We look at Sarah Huckabee Sanders' manufactured war on her own Christian identity, the misrepresented facts behind Kennedy v. Bremerton, and Florida candidate Rod Joseph's claim that being gay is biologically impossible, a claim that falls apart the moment you look at actual animal behavior. Tennessee candidate Matt Fritz wants Islam banned outright. Christian influencer Sarah Elizabeth Tenney says she had six kids to keep the white race from going extinct. Every claim gets checked against primary sources. Every quote gets played in context. If you've wondered how Christian nationalist rhetoric turns fabricated grievance into a justification for real violence, this traces it step by step.
